descriptionChirho: To melt, dissolve, or waste away, used of physical melting (wax, earth) and metaphorical dissolution (hearts melting in fear, people losing courage), in Qal intransitive, Nifal, and Hitpael stems.
To cause something or someone to melt, dissolve, or soften, used of God dissolving a person, consuming a people, or softening the earth with rain, in Piel and causative Qal constructions.
